cases.reason: Stage0 conservatively rechecks an outer owned move across loop iterations, including a trailing break.

Stage0 accepts consuming an outer owned local in a repeatedly evaluated while condition; a later condition evaluation can read the cleared owner. The subset explicitly rejects this boundary, and no stage0 runtime output is used as a correctness oracle.

Stage0 accepts borrowing a String for the left comparison operand and consuming its owner while evaluating the right operand. The subset rejects this ownership boundary; the observed stage0 false result is not adopted as a positive oracle.

Stage0 accepts consuming the indexed vector while evaluating its index; the checked descriptor can then be the moved-from zero value. The subset explicitly rejects this boundary and does not use the observed P-INDEX as a correct oracle.

Stage0 accepts consuming a vector while evaluating its reserve argument, then reserving the moved-from descriptor. The subset rejects the ownership boundary; stage0 runtime output is not adopted as a correctness oracle.
Checks left-to-right evaluation and panic outcome after a first owned element was constructed. Panic does not unwind; this is not an element-destruction or leak-free-panic claim.
